^they offered 3% discount if we wire 50% deposit by Friday at noon instead of the following Monday

^remaining balance is due on the 13th

^confirm wire details with Aris in Finance and use vendor code CAT-882

^if discount applies note it explicitly on the payment authorization

^double check their proposal includes late night snack delivery for the tech crew at 11 p.m. because that is a separate order for 15 boxed meals and should not be part of per head calculation

^crucially if we go Tier B anywhere you must get written confirmation from Saffron Bites that all nut based ingredients are excluded from the mushroom Wellington filling

^last year's incident with the pine nut puree cannot be repeated

^their standard recipe includes it so this requires specific amendment
